follow-up time: From 30 weeks gestation through delivery for mothers, and up to 4-5 months of age for infants
exposure: CHOICE diet (60% complex carbohydrate/25% fat/15% protein)
Conventional diet (CONV, 40% complex carbohydrate/45% fat/15% protein)
cohort: 34 diet-controlled women with gestational diabetes mellitus.
finding: A higher-complex carbohydrate diet in women with GDM increased Bifidobacterium adolescentis levels and positively altered infant gut microbiome diversity compared to a conventional diet.
